# Proofed

> Proofed is a managed proofreading and editing agency offering professional content editing, quality assurance, and formatting services for businesses, students, and specialized industries.

Proofed provides expert human editing and proofreading across multiple sectors including legal, financial, publishing, and e-learning. The platform serves both individual writers and enterprise teams with 750+ professional editors, offering specialized services for AI-generated content, fact-checking, and managed editorial workflows.

## Core Services

- [Business Proofreading Services](https://proofed.com): Proofed homepage: expert managed proofreading and editing services.
- [Professional Proofreading for Business](https://proofed.com/services/proofreading): Professional proofreading services for business content and credibility.
- [Copy Editing Services](https://proofed.com/services/copy-editing): Proofed copy editing services with 750+ professional editors.
- [AI-Generated Content Editing](https://proofed.com/services/ai-content-editing): Human editing for AI-generated content with 100% quality assurance.
- [Fact-Checking for AI Content](https://proofed.com/services/ai-fact-checking): Fact-checking service for AI-generated business content accuracy.
- [Document Formatting Services](https://proofed.com/services/formatting): Professional document formatting with 24-hour turnarounds.

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [Legal Proofreading Services](https://proofed.com/legal): Legal document proofreading for law firms and compliance.
- [Financial Document Proofreading](https://proofed.com/financial-services): Financial document proofreading for reports and compliance.
- [Publishing and Media Editing](https://proofed.com/publishing-media): Publishing and media editing following AP and Chicago Manual styles.
- [Insurance Document Editing](https://proofed.com/insurance): Insurance document editing with specialist proofreading expertise.
- [Market Research Report Editing](https://proofed.com/market-intelligence): Market research report editing and intelligence content services.
- [E-Learning Editing & QA](https://proofed.com/elearning): eLearning editing and QA for courseware and LMS platforms.
- [Grant Proposal Editing](https://proofed.com/grant-proposals): Grant proposal editing for competitive funding applications.
